name: Signal
description: Dark signal-driven presentation system for strategy, market intelligence, operations, and high-stakes decision rooms.
localized_description: 面向战略、市场情报和运营决策的深色信号体系，用指标、对比和关键判断制造清晰的视觉焦点。

layouts.description: Dark cover with a single signal statement and a quiet grid field.
One dominant metric, one context line, and a compact diagnostic strip.
Dense but legible dashboard with three signals and one decision banner.
Risk and opportunity matrix with highlighted decision quadrant.
Incident or response timeline with severity markers and owners.
Case study split with a large visual panel and measurable outcome cards.
Decision statement with a short quote, source, and implication block.
Closing slide that turns the evidence into one next move and owner.
